entries.tactical_pattern_quoted: This cluster recasts an opaque transparency question about an already-trained model or dataset — which feature/datum/internal component is responsible, how uncertain a prediction is, what a hidden representation encodes — as a concrete measurement over a well-studied object: a manifold-constrained counterfactual optimization, a submodular subset selection, an expectation/estimator over marginal statistics, an additive decomposition into a (often sparse) basis, or an influence/Shapley score accumulated along the optimization trajectory.
